name: Umdlavuza webele nezigaxa
tagline: Zihlole, uzihlole, nokuthi wenzeni uma uthola isigaxa.

urgent.heading: Bheka umtholampilo kuleli sonto uma
urgent.primary_message: Isigaxa esisha sebele, ukukhishwa kwezingono, ukubola kwesikhumba, noma izinguquko zomumo — ungalindi. Ihlole. Iningi aliwona umdlavuza, kodwa lawo adinga isinyathelo esisheshayo.

what_is_it.heading: Umdlavuza webele ngamagama alula
what_is_it.lede: Umdlavuza webele umdlavuza oqala emangqamuzaneni ebele - ngokuvamile emiseleni yobisi noma ezindlaleni ezikhiqiza ubisi. Izigaxa eziningi zamabele aziwona umdlavuza, kodwa zonke izigaxa ezintsha zidinga ukuhlolwa.
paragraphs: Umdlavuza webele uvame kakhulu kwabesifazane baseNingizimu Afrika. Cishe oyedwa kwabangama-27 uzoyithuthukisa ekuphileni kwakhe. Amadoda angathola nomdlavuza webele, nakuba ungavamile kakhulu - cishe oyedwa kwabayi-1,000.

Uma ubanjwa kusenesikhathi - ngaphambi kokuba usakazeke - umdlavuza webele uyelapheka kakhulu. Iminyaka emihlanu yokusinda komdlavuza webele osesigabeni sokuqala eNingizimu Afrika ingaphezu kwama-80%. Inselele eNingizimu Afrika ukubonwa sekwephuzile: abesifazane abaningi babona udokotela kuphela uma umdlavuza usuthuthukile, lapho ukwelashwa kuba nzima futhi nemiphumela iba mibi kakhulu.

items.headline: 1 ku27
items.body: Abesifazane baseNingizimu Afrika bazoba nomdlavuza webele ekuphileni kwabo. Ingozi ikhuphuka kakhulu ngemva kweminyaka engama-50.

items.headline: Izigaxa eziningi azilungile
items.body: Cishe izigaxa zebele eziyi-8 kweziyi-10 aziwona umdlavuza - ama-cysts, ama-fibroadenomas, noma izinguquko ezivamile zebele. Kodwa zonke izigaxa ezintsha zisadinga ukuhlolwa.

items.headline: Early = ukusinda
items.body: Ukusinda kweminyaka emihlanu kungaphezu kwama-80% uma kubanjwa kusenesikhathi, kwehla kakhulu uma kutholwa sekwephuzile. Ukutholwa kusenesikhathi kuyisici esisodwa esikhulu somphumela.

items.headline: Ukuhlolwa kwamahhala
items.body: Ukuhlolwa kwamabele emtholampilo kwamahhala kuyo yonke imitholampilo. Amamammograms mahhala ezibhedlela zikahulumeni kwabesifazane abangaphezu kweminyaka engama-40 abanezici eziyingozi. Ukuhlolwa kweselula kwe-CANSA nakho.

pull_quote.text: Izigaxa zamabele eziningi aziwona umdlavuza. Kodwa awukwazi ukubona ngokuzizwa uwedwa. Sonke isigaxa esisha esingasuki emjikelezweni owodwa wokuya esikhathini sifanelwe ukuvakashelwa emtholampilo. 'Ungalindi futhi ubone' izinyanga.

signs.heading: Okufanele ukubheke
signs.lede: Yazi ukuthi amabele akho ngokuvamile abukeka kanjani futhi azizwa kanjani. Izinguquko kusukela kokujwayelekile kwakho yizona ezibalulekile - hhayi ukuthi amabele akho aqhathaniswe newomunye umuntu.

items.title: Izigaxa nokujiya
items.description: Isigaxa esisha ebeleni noma ekhwapheni. Indawo ezwakala ihlukile - iqinile, iminyene, noma ijiyile kunezicubu ezizungezile. Iningi aliwona umdlavuza kodwa wonke adinga ukubhekwa.

items.title: Ukushintsha kwesimo noma isikhumba
items.description: Ibele elilodwa elibukeka lihlukile kunangaphambili — usayizi, umumo, noma ukushintsha indawo. I-Dimpling, i-puckering, noma isikhumba se-orange-peel. Ububomvu obuqhubekayo noma ukuqubuka.

items.title: Ingono iyashintsha
items.description: Ingono iphendukela ngaphakathi (entsha), ukukhishwa okungelona ubisi lwebele (ikakhulukazi okunegazi noma okucacile ohlangothini olulodwa), noma umqubuko engonweni.

items.myth: Umdlavuza webele wehlela abesifazane asebekhulile kuphela.
items.fact: Ingozi ikhuphuka kakhulu ngemva kweminyaka engama-50, kodwa umdlavuza webele uyenzeka kunoma iyiphi iminyaka. Umdlavuza wabesifazane abasebancane uvame ukuba nolaka kakhulu - iqembu ngalinye leminyaka yobudala lidinga ukwazi izimpawu.

items.myth: Uma kungekho muntu emndenini wami oke waba nomdlavuza webele, ngiphephile.
items.fact: Cishe umdlavuza wamabele owodwa kuphela kwabayishumi ohlotshaniswa ngokusobala nezakhi zofuzo. Iningi lenzeka kwabesifazane abangenawo umlando womndeni. Wonke umuntu udinga ukwazi izimpawu.

items.myth: Ukugqoka ubhodisi noma ukusebenzisa isiqedaphunga kubangela umdlavuza webele.
items.fact: Akukho futhi okubonisiwe ukuthi kubangele umdlavuza webele kunoma yiluphi ucwaningo oluthembekile. Lezi yizinganekwane eziphazamisa izinto ezibalulekile - ukutholwa kusenesikhathi kanye nezici eziyingozi ezaziwayo.

items.myth: Isigaxa esincane akuyona into yokukhathazeka ngaso.
items.fact: Usayizi awukutsheli ukuthi isigaxa siwumdlavuza. Eminye imidlavuza enolaka mincane uma itholakala; izigaxa eziningi ezinkulu aziwona umdlavuza. Hlola noma yisiphi isigaxa esisha - ngaphandle kosayizi.

prevention.heading: Indlela yokunciphisa ingozi futhi uyibambe kusenesikhathi
prevention.lede: Ezinye izici eziyingozi ongeke uziguqule (iminyaka yobudala, izakhi zofuzo, ubulili). Abaningi ongakwenza. Ukutholwa kusenesikhathi kuyisibikezelo esinamandla sokusinda.

items.title: Yazi okujwayelekile kwakho
items.description: Bheka futhi uzwe amabele akho kanye ngenyanga, kahle ngemva kokuya esikhathini. Ushintsho olusuka kokujwayelekile kwakho lubalulekile - jwayelana nokuthi yini 'okuvamile' kuwe.

items.title: Ukuhlolwa komtholampilo emtholampilo
items.description: Ukuhlolwa kwamabele emtholampilo kwamahhala kunoma yimuphi umtholampilo kahulumeni - minyaka yonke kusukela eminyakeni engama-30. Abasebenzi bezempilo bathola izinto ongase uziphuthele.

items.title: I-Mammogram kusuka ku-40
items.description: Ama-mammograms anconywa njalo eminyakeni emi-2 kusukela eminyakeni engama-40, ngonyaka uma kunengozi enkulu. Izibhedlela zikahulumeni zinikeza ama-mammograms mahhala kwabesifazane abasengozini.

items.title: Izici zendlela yokuphila
items.description: Gcina isisindo esinempilo, nciphisa utshwala (ngaphansi kwesiphuzo esingu-1 ngosuku), sebenza ngokomzimba, ncelisa uma ukwazi. Lokhu kunciphisa ingozi ngesizotha kodwa ngendlela enenjongo.

items.title: Uma uthola isigaxa esisha
items.description: Qaphela ukuthi uyitholile nini. Bonana nomtholampilo emasontweni amabili ezayo. Uma ususondele noma usudlulile ekunqamukeni kokuya esikhathini, ungalindi noma yimuphi 'umjikelezo' — bona othile ngokushesha.

items.title: Zihlole nyanga zonke
items.description: Kanye ngenyanga, ngemva kokuya esikhathini. Bheka esibukweni uphakamise izingalo. Izwa ibele ngalinye kanye nekhwapha ngokunyakazisa isiyingi. Emile ecambalala. Imizuzu emihlanu.

items.title: Ukuhlolwa komtholampilo kwaminyaka yonke kusuka ku-30
items.description: Hamba uye kunoma yimuphi umtholampilo. Cela ukuhlolwa kwebele emtholampilo. Kumahhala, kuthatha imizuzu, futhi uthola izinto ongeke ukwazi ukuzizwa ngokwakho.

items.title: I-Mammogram kusukela eminyakeni engama-40
items.description: Njalo eminyakeni emi-2 ukusuka ku-40, minyaka yonke uma kusengozini enkulu (umlando womndeni, amabele aminyene, isakhi sofuzo se-BRCA). Kuyadabukisa kodwa kuyashesha — futhi kusindisa ukuphila.

items.title: Uma uxilongwa - fika esikhungweni somdlavuza
items.description: Ukwelashwa kuphumelela kakhulu ezikhungweni ezinkulu zomdlavuza ezibhedlela. Buza mayelana nokudluliselwa. I-CANSA ingasiza ukuzulazula ohlelweni.

get_help.heading: Lapho okumele uye khona
get_help.lede: Ukunakekelwa komdlavuza webele eNingizimu Afrika kuhlelwe kahle ezikhungweni ezinkulu. Uma kuqala kusistimu oyifakayo, iba ngcono imiphumela.
